summary: Session 4 of 4: WALK IT, FIX WHAT IT BREAKS, SHIP IT. Extension 0.49.0 is staged (63 files, 1.42MB); publishing and tagging remain operator-gated. It supersedes the staged-but-never-published 0.48.0 and carries that version's narrow-panel fix and template link corrections into a shipping artifact for the first time. THE MEASUREMENT THE SET WAS OPENED FOR NOW EXISTS AND IT SAYS THE MIGRATION DID NOT FIX THE SYMPTOM. The three populated scales improve (5344/5293/5606 -> 3074/3746/5532 ms view-open to first row), but the 0-set scale -- the one the sluggishness hypothesis actually lives at -- is 99% a single git worktree list subprocess, so empty-tree cost is host-side discovery and no view technology removes it. Stated as an internal ratio within one run, because the before/after runs were taken on different machines (cpus 20/node v25.8.1 vs cpus 14/node v24.19.0); that also retires the previously-'unresolved' 3.7-4.3x scan anomaly as an environment candidate rather than a code hunt, and voids cross-run absolute deltas, which are no longer claimed. The <1000 ms gate is MISSED at every scale and is an explicitly deferred residual with its own follow-on, never a waiver. SEVEN VERIFICATION ROUNDS, AND EVERY ONE EARNED ITS KEEP -- four of them found defects that would have shipped. R1 (gemini-3.1-pro-preview): the release was never actually staged, and the fourth scale was never measured. R2: THE UAT FIX WAS ITSELF THE DEFECT -- contributes.viewsContainers.icon was set to a {light,dark} object, which isValidViewsContainer rejects, dropping the WHOLE activitybar array, so the Dabbler container would not have registered at all; and it could not have worked anyway, because VS Code masks that icon (fill discarded, colour from the theme) and the two files had BYTE-IDENTICAL path data. Three gates were green over it: the last full Layer 3 predated the manifest edit, no Layer 2/typecheck/build path reads a manifest icon, and verify_vsix_claims.py ASSERTED THE BUG as its expectation. The repo had already documented this trap from the other side -- status-icon-theming.md records S1 and S2 both recommending currentColor for the STATUS icons by reasoning from the activity-bar icon; S4 made the mirror image. The operator's contrast complaint is REOPENED and the CHANGELOG's 'Fixed' claim withdrawn to Known issues, because a per-theme asset cannot answer it. R3: the release gate overclaimed -- one script was said to verify every CHANGELOG claim while checking 11 coarse predicates; fixed both ways the finding allowed, with 3 new artifact-decidable checks (all 19 row actions gated on view AND contextValue, both submenus populated and attached, normalizeLedgerSessions ships) falsified by mutating a copy of the real VSIX, plus a claim-by-claim map naming which gate covers each behavioural claim. R4 (close backstop): transport.profile: copilot-cli had been committed into router-config.yaml, which pyproject ships as PACKAGE DATA -- a fresh wheel install with keys and no seat could not have loaded the router. Root cause was not carelessness: the profile had no supported local home and clone-setup.md actively told operators to edit the tracked file. Took both remedies -- reverted to api AND made transport.profile a supported local-overrides.yaml key, merged pre-validation so a local copilot-cli still satisfies the transports block check. R6: the staged VSIX was STALE (packed e26e5023/1237082 vs built 03bbab69/1238155) and still shipped R5's defect, while verify_vsix_claims.py reported ALL CLAIMS VERIFIED -- because every check reads the ARCHIVE. Added the 15th check comparing packaged bundle to dist/extension.js; it fires on the stale artifact while the other 14 stay green. R6 also found the ignore rule the whole R4 remediation rests on WAS NEVER WRITTEN by anyone. R7: fixed at one creator was not enough -- the config editor is a SECOND creator of the same file, making the same promise while doing the same damage. The right question was never 'who creates this file?' but 'what must be true whenever it exists?'. R7's nit was a genuine FALSE POSITIVE in the dangerous direction: '/local-overrides.yaml' is root-anchored and never matches the file under ai_router/, so a repo carrying that rule would have been reported protected while fully committable. R8: VERIFIED, zero findings. EVERY new gate is falsified, not merely observed passing -- the viewsContainer icon contract against the object shape and a per-theme string; the VSIX claims by mutating a real archive; the ignore guarantee by seeding the pre-fix no-op; the config-editor pin by renaming the call away. RECORDED, NOT FIXED, for Step 9: the router's own suite is not seat-aware (3446 passed/16 failed on this keyless Copilot seat, but 372/372 on the affected files under the shipped api profile with keys), and the drift guard's keyless degradation asserts a passing string instead of skipping. FINAL GATES on the final tree after the last code change: typecheck clean, Layer 2 1886 passing/1 pending, Layer 3 33 passed/0 failed (11.3m), VSIX 15/15. Human UAT was performed and all four items returned Passes: false with substantive feedback; the tree-icon findings were remediated, the invalid-manifest path could not be walked (recorded as a gap, not an attestation), and clearer session labels, the activity-bar contrast complaint and the startup investigation are explicit deferred residuals.
